method: Every attack was applied to a DISPOSABLE COPY outside Git. The real repository, the frozen package candidate and the real capsule were never mutated.

refusal_stage_breakdown.honest_reading: REFUSED means execution was impossible, not that every run identified the tampering. A template-level case that stopped at the signature gate is refused but NOT detected there; detection of that same field is proven on SIGNED bytes by the corresponding SIG-* case. Both properties are required, and both are recorded separately here rather than merged into one flattering number.
